justifications.D1: "If SE_batch_level > 50% of the observed effect, flag the gate as unresolvable" — the wrong-unit and gate-in-noise failure modes are converted into F2's detection gate, with batch-size heterogeneity modeled as the object of study.
justifications.D3: "Early stop if F4 or F5 is triggered during preflight (n_eff < 10 or extreme outlier weights)" — a cheap early falsifier independent of the heteroskedasticity mechanism, plus six numeric thresholds and explicit stopping rules.
justifications.D4: "Compute weights under robust covariance estimation... If they diverge, the effect is sensitive to outliers" — each summary confound isolated by a concrete element, but no synthetic positive control demonstrating recovery of a known planted effect.
justifications.D5: "Arm B goes further: it tracks... whether batch size predicts outcome stability, a second-order confound within batch-level analysis itself" — explicit new cell beyond the settled unit-of-analysis doctrine.
justifications.D6: "Non-null verdicts for F3–F6 are discoveries (heterogeneity, confounding, brittleness), not failures" — every branch, including the unresolvable-gate vacuous reading (F2), is pre-committed.

justifications.D1: "The preregistered falsification threshold, computed at batch level with full CI, will NOT be reachable by naive row-level inference" — the wrong-unit trap is made a measured prediction, with F3 detecting the pseudoreplication failure if present.
justifications.D3: "F5 (Effective n too small): n_batches < 10... Early stop if F5 is triggered during preflight" — a cheap early design-failure falsifier plus numeric F1-F4 and explicit stopping rules.
justifications.D4: "Compute SE BEFORE preregistration. Require gate to be >= 2 SE away from plausible values" — the summary's confounds each get concrete defenses (stratification, resolution match, Levene), but no positive control demonstrating the pipeline recovers a known signal.
justifications.D5: "supplemented by stratified subanalyses checking whether batch size moderates or confounds the observed effect" — implements the expected doctrine with a moderation extension, without explicitly naming the new empirical cell.
justifications.D6: "Aggregate effect is near zero, but the heterogeneity is the finding" — each failure branch maps to a distinct pre-committed conclusion, including the F2 unresolvable-gate vacuous reading.

justifications.D1: "the wiki's one on-point precedent shows the clustering fix alone produced a result that still did not survive replication" — both prior defects (57x SE inflation, fold dominance) are converted into mandatory detection gates (inflation ratio first-class, jackknife, held-out replication).
justifications.D3: "if removing the single largest batch... changes the sign of D, or drops D/SE_cluster below 2.0, the result is reclassified FOLD_DOMINANCE_ARTIFACT" with an interim early stop — a cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier plus five numeric gates and explicit stopping rules.
justifications.D4: "Positive control: inject a batch-level effect of known magnitude into a held-out synthetic corpus... and verify the pipeline recovers it" — every summary confound isolated plus an explicit instrument-sensitivity check.
justifications.D5: "they are preregistered here as this task's own gate, not as an imported validated constant" for "a genuinely different substrate (batch decisions rather than h4 invariant cells)" — explicitly names the new cell relative to the precedent.
justifications.D6: "the design-set result is RETRACTED, full stop, independent of how large the design-set statistic was" — every branch carries a named verdict including INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTERS and FOLD_DOMINANCE_ARTIFACT.

justifications.D1: "Forbidden quantity, stated explicitly: any SE computed as if N = total row count. Its presence in a report is treated as a defect, not a different opinion" — the wrong-unit failure is made mechanically impossible and detectable via the gate-fire worlds and a hard code assertion.
justifications.D3: "If, in the null gate-fire world, the batch-bootstrap empirical coverage... falls below 90%... the bootstrap implementation is rejected and not used on real data until fixed" — a cheap pre-data mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric falsifiers 2-4 and a variance-based stopping rule fixed before the pilot.
justifications.D4: "Size-confound world... must diverge in the planted direction and by an amount within 20% of the analytically expected divergence" — three synthetic gate-fire worlds function as positive controls on top of full confound coverage (autocorrelation, nesting, formation rule).
justifications.D5: "the specific risk here... is new territory, not a re-run of either precedent — hence this is a design specification, not a replication" — explicit new-cell statement relative to both prior wrong-unit instances.
justifications.D6: "the result is marked UNDECIDED pending more batches, never rounded to a side" — every branch, including the methods-agree reversion (falsifier 2) and estimand-divergence readings, is pre-committed.
